summary: Iteration 4 e2e testing of Arxeon Elite (ZanePricing + SavingsCalculator + Swiss-claim purge). Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (added TestZaneTiers parametrized for Zane Lite/Business/Elite). Frontend: ALL 20 acceptance criteria from review request verified PASS via Playwright on external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

issues: Pre-existing from iteration_2 (out of scope this iteration): header-cta may still overflow on 390px viewport. Not retested as no Header.jsx layout change referenced beyond sub-bar copy.

critical_code_review_comments: ZanePricing.jsx (~150 LOC): clean component. data-testids zane-pricing-section, zane-plan-{0,1,2}, zane-plan-name-{i}, zane-plan-highlight-1 (Business only), zane-plan-cta-{i} all present. Business CTA correctly uses gold-fill class 'bg-[#d4af37]'. Lite/Elite use outlined gold border. All 3 CTAs href='#contact'.

SavingsCalculator.jsx (~215 LOC): React useState + useMemo correctly compute annualSavings (verified 12 x 3 -> 435’600 CHF), annualHours (7'920), fteEquivalent (4.5). Hours input correctly clamped to max 8 (verified entering 99 → input value 8). Constants CHF_PER_HOUR=55, WORKING_DAYS_PER_YEAR=220, HOURS_PER_FTE_YEAR=1760 match spec. Uses Intl.NumberFormat('de-CH') giving '435’600' apostrophe separator format.

translations.js: All Swiss/svizzera/suisse/précision/precisione strings purged from VISIBLE DOM (verified case-insensitive scan of body innerText in both IT and FR). Hero IT subtitle correctly starts 'Più tempo per il founder.' Strategy IT title 'High-Ticket. Volume automatizzato. Margini protetti.' present, point #03 'Output Costante' present, no 'Precisione Svizzera' / 'Equilibrio svizzero'. FR equivalents 'High-Ticket. Volume automatisé. Marges protégées.' and calc title 'Combien vous coûte l'inefficacité' verified.
ValueLadder.jsx: tier-cta-0 href='#roi-calculator' (points to SavingsCalculator section), tier-cta-1 href='#zane-pricing'. Highlights 'ROI 60 GIORNI' (tier-0) and 'PIÙ RICHIESTO' (tier-1) verified.
Header.jsx sub-bar shows 'B2B · Riservato · Su selezione' (rendered uppercase via CSS text-transform; underlying text matches spec). 'Swiss Made' absent.
Footer.jsx shows 'B2B · IT / FR · Arxeon Elite'. 'Made with precision' absent.

ContactForm.jsx tier options correctly extended: tier-option-zane-lite, tier-option-zane-business, tier-option-zane-elite all clickable; e2e submit with 'Zane Business' creates MongoDB record with tier='Zane Business' (verified via GET /api/consultation).
Section order verified via abs document Y: value-ladder → zane-pricing → savings-calculator → elite-intro → architecture → pillars → blueprint → strategy → contact (all monotonically ascending).

Backend server.py unchanged from prior iterations; Pydantic ConsultationRequestCreate accepts arbitrary tier strings (Optional[str], max_length=80) which is exactly what new Zane Lite/Business/Elite values need.

Minor note: ContactForm form-field data-testids are 'form-company', 'form-email', 'form-phone' (NOT 'form-company-input'). The review request mentioned 'form-success' which DOES exist after submit. No fix needed.
